name: Asa Linen
description: A serene, organic store theme for a small linen bedding atelier, with WooCommerce templates styled to match. Flax washi pages with a faint linen weave drawn in CSS, stone panels, warm ink text and one faded sage accent; Crimson Pro for display, Nunito Sans for text. A transparent header lies over the opening photograph of a made bed and turns solid washi as the page scrolls (H8); the home page then follows four chapters (flax, weave, wash, sleep) scrolling beside a sticky photograph of the made bed (L13), then the three families of bedding, a care and delivery note and the journal. A Fabric guide (linen weights, weave and finish, a size table) and a Care page (four habits, what to avoid, delivery and returns); atelier, journal, newsletter and contact pages. A photo-strip footer of five softly faded photographs over a stone colophon with the visit rows of the synced atelier card (F8). The atelier address, hours, email and the care, delivery and returns policy live in one synced pattern used by the footer, the Care page and the Contact page; every product shows its linen weight, kept once as a product attribute (WooCommerce optional: without it the shop page shows the synced shelf and orders go by email).
deviation: Palette, fonts, style tags and H8 + F8 + L13 are as planned (combination unused: Hana Kago is H8/F4/L8, Undo Ba H8/F7/L12, Komugi Pan and Kinu Kimono use F8 with other headers/layouts, Wagu Mono is L13 with H3). The faded sage #8C8F7A is 2.9:1 on washi, so it is kept to hairlines, chapter numerals, the weave mark and large marks; links and small labels use deep sage #5A5E4C (5.7:1 on washi), secondary text quiet ink #5B564D (5.9:1 on washi, 4.6:1 on stone); pale washi #F8F6F1 panels and light sage #C3C6B2 were added. H8 differs from Hana Kago and Undo Ba by a washi veil over a light photograph with ink type (not light type on a dark photo), fading to solid washi with a hairline via a CSS scroll timeline (script fallback). F8 differs from Komugi Pan and Kinu Kimono by five square, softly desaturated photographs with spaced-capital captions (flax, weave, wash, cut, fold) over a stone colophon with the synced atelier card. L13 differs from Wagu Mono by a framed photograph of a made bed (not a drawing plate) beside four numbered chapters with small photographs and a quote. Both fonts verified OFL-1.1 without a Reserved Font Name (google/fonts ofl/crimsonpro, ofl/nunitosans): Crimson Pro instanced to weights 300-500 (roman + italic), Nunito Sans pinned to opsz 12 / wdth 100 / YTLC 500 with weights 300-700, both subset to Latin WOFF2. The Care page uses the existing generic page tag care-guide (the existing tag care is labelled Knife care); the page itself is /care/. Product photographs are 4:5 crops of the supplied photographs (the Sage Edge set, Stone trio, Fringed throw and Folded flat sheet are crops of the hero bed, pillow, weave and care photographs). Added a newsletter page because check-themes requires it; industry linen-bedding and page tag fabric-guide are new.
